chapters.title: 1_Playdough Mini Kitchen - Italian Market Intro and Directions

tracks.title: 1_Playdough Mini Kitchen - Italian Market Intro and Directions

metadata.description: Welcome to Playdough Mini Kitchen-Italian Market, where your child becomes a chef in their very own Italian kitchen! With fun and detailed audio prompts, kids will make everything from pizza and pasta to meatballs, salads, breadsticks, and more, all out of playdough! Soft music sets the tone while your child works at their own pace, building pretend meals and creative dishes. This interactive audio boosts imagination, encourages pretend play, and helps keep kids engaged in screen-free fun.
